blocks.text: Miss Philippines Earth 2025 Joy Barcoma has called on “Pinoy Big Brother” (PBB) to cast ordinary Filipinos for its next season. Her statement comes after ABS-CBN and GMA called a halt on the 24/7 livestreams for “PBB Celebrity Collab 3.0” due to rampant online harassment. Barcoma initially expressed shock on Threads when the networks cut the live feeds on Saturday, Nov. 21. She soon followed up with a series of posts about Philippine reality television culture and viewer expectations.
